methodologyNotes: Covers compact standmount (bookshelf) hi-fi loudspeakers sold at a published US MSRP, both passive (require an external amplifier) and active/powered (built-in amplification). Excludes floorstanding towers, in-wall/on-wall and satellite speakers, portable Bluetooth speakers, smart speakers, soundbars, and nearfield studio monitors. Price is typical US MSRP in USD, per pair unless the model is sold singly. amplification is an enum: 'passive' or 'active'. wooferSizeIn is the mid-woofer cone diameter in inches (nominal). tweeterType is an enum describing the high-frequency driver: 'silk-dome', 'aluminum-dome', 'amt', 'ribbon', or 'concentric' (coaxial). enclosureType is an enum: 'sealed' or 'ported' (bass-reflex). frequencyResponseHz is the quoted low-to-high range in Hz as a 'low-high' string (tolerance conventions vary by maker). sensitivityDb is speaker sensitivity in dB at 2.83V/1m (passive models; null for active). nominalImpedanceOhms is rated impedance in ohms (passive models; null for active). amplifierPowerW is total built-in RMS amplifier power in watts per pair (active models; null for passive). crossoverFrequencyHz is the crossover point in Hz; null if not disclosed. dimensionsInches is per-speaker Height x Width x Depth in inches. weightPoundsEach is the mass of a single speaker in pounds.
